headline: Going Commando's refreshed report reaches 6.51% matched code
summary: Going Commando's USA v1.01 matched code rose from 5.75% to 6.51% in the refreshed progress report (#206). Its 3,303 finished entries comprise 3,052 C functions and 251 original handwritten assembly routines. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. This reports previously merged work rather than adding new implementations.
